title: myrsine lanceolata subsp. ouenarouensis
intro: Myrsine lanceolata subsp. ouenarouensis, commonly known as Ouena Rosemy, is a plant species in the Myrsinaceae family. It is a shrub native to the island of Corsica, France. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ouena Rosemy include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
